tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i byin 'bebs kyi rol yig mthong ba rang grol gsal byed mdzes rgyan bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra kī lā ya/ dpal rdo rje phur pa'i byin 'bebs kyi rol yig sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa mthong ba ral grol nag 'gros su bkod pa las/ rgyas pa'i rgyas pa ni/ thog mar rol mo bcom pa zhes 'phar gsum gyi rjes su chems brdung yun ci rigs/ de dang byin 'bebs dngos gzhi'i mtshams gcod kyi 'phar chen gcig 'di yan rol mo kha sbyar/ de nas steng gi rol mo 'og gi rol mo la g.yas su bskor te kha bslang la steng gi rol mo'i gshogs pa 'og gi rol mo'i 'go phul gyi steng la cung zad brdab cing rol dpon gyis rol gra bsgrigs pa'i rjes su rol mo ba gang yod kyi'ang de bzhin du 'phar chung blangs ste gcig nas nyer gcig gi bar grangs bzung ba ni/ chung nyer gcig zhes pa'i dgongs pa yin la/ yang rol mo kha sbyar ba mtshams gcod kyi rol mo dang / de nas gcig nas nyer gcig gi bar kha sbyar 'phar brdeb ni che nyer gcig zhes pa'i dgongs pa yin yang rol gra bsgrigs pa dang / chung nyer gcig mtshams che gnyis gcig yang che chung de bzhin te/ khug pa gsum po de la rgyud gsum zhes grags/ che nyer gcig rjes ma'i rjes su rol yig na med kyang phyag len la mtshams gcod mtshon byin kha sbyar 'phar chung gcig mdzad/ 'di man kha sbyar kho na yin/ chig brdung gsum/ nyis brdung gsum/ gsum brdung gsum/ bzhi brdung gsum/ lnga brdung gsum/ drug brdung gsum/ 'di yan shin tu dal zhing ring ba ste/ snga thog gshog pa gcig brdeb dang / deng sang gshog pa phan tshun gnyis char myur sor brdab nas dkrol ba la ngag rgyun du 'phar len pa zhes su grags/ rol mo 'phar len pa zhes pa thams cad 'di'i rigs 'gre phyag len la drug brdung rjes man ni drug zhes pa la 'phar mi len pa drug zhes nem thung gcig mdzad/

nem thung zhes pa rol mo steng ma de 'og ma'i kha yam byas pa zhig la ngos 'dzin/ 'di man la 'phar mi len pa dkyus dkrol zhes kha sbyar brdeb thang re re'i grangs bzung nas/ bdun brdung gsum/ brgyad brdung gsum gi dgu brdung du song ngo snyam na dgu brdung dngos dang cung mi 'dra ste rol yig las/ de yang brgyad brdung la bdun gyi thad du nem pa gcig byas brgyad la mtho bar bteg dgu'i steng du phab la/ de nas chung bar brdeg go gsungs pa bzhin mthong brgyud phyag len la 'khrul med bzhugs/ dgu brdeg gsum/ 'di la bdun nem pa dang / brgyad bteg dang / dgur phab pa mi dgos pa dkyus gcig la dkrol/ bcu gcig brdeg gsum/ 'di la dgur nem bcur bteg bcu gcig la phab pa'i rjes su chung / bcu gcig brdeg gsum/ 'di la nem bteg phab pa mi dgos par dkyus gcig la dkrol/ bcu gcig brdeg rjes ma'i rjes su chung / theng brdung gnyis/ rol mo che zhing dal brel ran pa lnga bcu/ che drag myur lnga bcu chems brdung yun ci rigs/ bcom len gyi rol mo chung ba dang theng brdung gnyis gsum brdeg che ba dang theng brdung gcig che gcig ste mthong ba rang grol sor bzhag dang phyag len la de'i rjes su steng gi rol mo 'og gi steng du kha bslang / g.yon bskor la rol bskor dang zhes dang / de'i rjes su 'phar gyi mur 'jog ba la 'bebs ces grags/ rol bskor 'bebs bcas zhes pa thams cad 'di'i rigs 'gre/ rol mo grangs 'di ma nor ba ji bzhin byung na mngon rtogs rgyas pa nyams len byas pa dang phan yon 'dra/ rgyas pa'i bsdus pa ni/ bcom ni kha slang gi rol gra bsgrigs pa'i bar 'dra/ chung brdung che brdung / de 'dra tshar gsum gyi che brdung rjes ma'i rjes su chung gcig gcig brdung nas drug brdung gi bar du kha sbyar 'phar brdeb/ 'on kyang drug gi drug ces pa gong gi drug brdung rjes ma bzhin bdun brdung nas bcu gcig brdung gi bar yang re re gong bzhin/

bcu gcig brdung gi rjes su theng brdung gnyis/ rgya tshab ji ltar ring pa byas gsungs pa'i che dal brel ran pa nyer lnga/ chung je myur la btang ba nyer lnga/ chems brdung man gong bzhin no/ ༈ /'bring po'i rgyas pa ni bcom nas kha slang rol gra sgrigs pa'i bar 'dra/ chung bco lnga mtshams gcod che bcu bzhi/ rol sgrigs dang chung bcu gsum/ mtshams gcod dang che bcu gnyis/ rol sgrigs dang chung bcu gcig mtshams gcod dang che gcig rol sgrigs dang chung bcu/ mtshams gcod dang che gnyis/ de bzhin du rol sgrigs dang mtshams gcod/ 'di nas 'og ma thams cad la rigs 'gre/ chung dgu che gsum chung brgyad che bzhi/ chung bdun/ che lnga/ chung drug che drug chung lnga/ che bdun/ chung bzhi/ che brgyad/ 'di yan gyi chung rnams kha bslang dang / che rnams kha sbyar 'phar brdeb yin/ 'di man la kha sbyar kho na las kha bslang mi dgos/ chung gsum/ che dgu/ chung gnyis/ che bcu/ chung gcig 'di yan la 'phar len/ de nas dkyus rol gyi che bcu gcig theng brdung gnyis/ che bco lnga/ theng brdung gnyis/ che bcu bdun gyi bco lnga la nem bcu drug la bteg bcu bdun la phab rjes/ chung gcig theng brdung gnyis/ che bcu dgu'i bcu bdun la nem bco brgyad la bteg bcu dgu phab rjes chung gcig theng brdung gnyis/ che nyer gcig gi bcu dgu la nem nyi shu la bteg nyer gcig la phab rjes chung gcig theng brdung gnyis chems brdung man gong bzhin/ 'bring po'i bsdus pa ni/ bcom dang rol sgrigs mtshams gcod sogs gong gi rgyas bkab la/ chung bcu gcig che bcu gcig byas pa gnyis/ chung bcu gcig che gcig 'thab pa nas bzung che bcu dang / chung gcig 'thab pa'i bar kha bslangs dang kha sbyar 'pher rdebs rnams gong gi rigs 'gre dkyus rol gyi bcu gcig brdung gi rjes su 'then rkang gnyis byas pa tshar gsum chems brdung man gong bzhin/ byin 'bebs 'di nyid ni mngon rtogs 'bring po'i nyams len byas pa dang phan yon 'dra/

༈ /bsdus pa'i rgyas pa ni/ rol mo bcom zhing chems brdung / de nas 'phar ma bslangs par che gcig gi rjes su chung myur ba bcu/ de bas dal ba'i che bcu de bas kyang dal ba'i chung bcu shin tu dal ba'i 'phar blangs pa che bcu/ ji myur la btang ba'i che bzhi bcu/ chems brdung gsum brdeg lan can rol bskor 'bebs bcas so/ ༈ /bsdus pa'i bsdus pa ni/ rol mo bcom zhing chems brdung gi rjes su 'phar chen gcig 'phar chung gsum/ che gcig gi rjes su chung gcig che gnyis brdung nas bzung bcu gcig brdung gi bar rol mo dal brel dkrol lugs rgyas pa'i bsdus pa sor bzhag chems brdung sogs rgyas bsdus pa bzhin no/ /byin 'bebs 'di 'dra ni mngon rtogs bsdus pa nyams len byas pa dang phan yon 'dra/ ces dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i byin 'bebs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rol yig sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyi dgongs pa bzhin nag 'gros su bkod pa 'di yang zur 'chad ban tshang dbu byed rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs kyi bzhed skong du sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i byin 'bebs kyi rol yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
